E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

(Reality, Cookery) - 2012

When she meets Jason Taylor (Laz Alonso), she thinks she's found Mr. Right and eagerly accepts the Wall Street worker's marriage proposal after a whirlwind courtship. However, when Sabrina's aristocratic parents (Angela Bassett, Brian Stokes Mitchell) meet Jason's postal-worker mother (Loretta Devine) at their estate on Martha's Vineyard, the class division seems very wide indeed.

bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases: a comic fuming after her friend sold out their showcase but kept all the cash, a woman upset after her BFF wrecked her grandma's Chevy with a bad oil change, and a man ghosted after bankrolling.

bether.us.title: Glory
bether.us.description: Following the Battle of Antietam, Col. Robert Gould Shaw (Matthew Broderick) is offered command of the United States' first all-African-American regiment, the 54th Massachusetts Volunteer Infantry. With junior officer Cabot Forbes (Cary Elwes), Shaw puts together a strong and proud unit, including the escaped slave Trip (Denzel Washington) and the wise gravedigger John Rawlins (Morgan Freeman). At first limited to menial manual tasks, the regiment fights to be placed in the heat of battle. (movie) - 1989

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize.

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. (movie) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (movie) - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (movie) - 2001

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxaction.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Us
cinemaxaction.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Companion
cinemaxaction.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (movie) - 1989

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 1995

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Catfish
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In a prison cell somewhere in Latin America, two very different men warily confront each other. Molina (William Hurt) is first seen wrapping his head in a towel, in the shape of a turban, while Valentin (Raul Julia), bearded and classically macho in appearance, watches with a mixture of fascination and revulsion. During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Rodan
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - A Star Is Born
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - The Prince and the Pauper
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Trapped in a bizarre, bureaucratic afterlife, a famous Mohawk ghost is drawn into an encounter with an identical and partially-deceased descendant.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Talk Black
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Fantastic Planet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other?

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (movie) - 1964

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (movie) - 1972

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (movie) - 1973

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (movie) - 1974

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Head Office
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (movie) - 1986

cinemaxhits.us.title: Contagion
cinemaxhits.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Joker
cinemaxhits.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
cinemaxhits.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

cinemaxhits.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxhits.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Way, Way Back
cinemaxhits.us.description: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one.

cinemaxhits.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
cinemaxhits.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Smoking Tigers
cinemaxhits.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
cinemaxhits.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: Shazam!
cinemaxhits.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Judge
cinemaxwest.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemaxwest.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run.

cinemaxwest.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemaxwest.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxwest.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxwest.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxwest.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

cinemaxwest.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxwest.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (movie) - 2000

cinemaxwest.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxwest.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (movie) - 2005

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemaxwest.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. (movie) - 2017

cinesony.us.title: The Social Network
cinesony.us.description: Mark Zuckerberg, un estudiante de Harvard, crea la red social que terminará convirtiéndose en Facebook, pero recibe acusaciones del cofundador y de dos hermanos que sostienen que la idea fue suya.

cinesony.us.title: Saving Silverman
cinesony.us.description: Dos hombres inmaduros planean evitar que un amigo suyo se case con una mujer que, según ellos, no es la apropiada.

cinesony.us.title: Pineapple Express
cinesony.us.description: Dale Denton, cuyo trabajo es entregar citaciones legales, le compra marihuana a una mula que se llama Saúl. El traficante quiere hacerse amigo suyo, pero Dale solo está interesado en los negocios.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Southland Tales
cinesony.us.description: En un futuro distópico, los destinos de cuatro personas se entrelazan con los de toda la humanidad cuando una nueva tecnología amenaza con destruir el mundo.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Dragon Wars
cinesony.us.description: Ethan Kendrick (Jason Behr) descubre que unas criaturas antiguas llamadas Imoogi han regresado a la Tierra, y la única forma de detenerlas es con la ayuda de Sarah (Amanda Brooks). Basada en una leyenda coreana.

cinesony.us.title: Absolute Deception
cinesony.us.description: Una periodista hace equipo con un agente federal para descubrir la verdad detrás de la muerte de su esposo.

cinevault.us.title: Blue Streak
cinevault.us.description: When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey.

cinevault.us.title: It Could Happen to You
cinevault.us.description: Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

cinevault.us.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
cinevault.us.description: Peggy Sue Bodell (Kathleen Turner) attends her 25-year high school reunion after separating from her cheating husband, Charlie (Nicolas Cage). She regrets the decisions she has made in her life, such as getting pregnant by Charlie in high school. When she faints at the reunion, she awakens in 1960. Given the chance to relive her life, she changes many things. However, some choices are more complicated, as she begins to see young Charlie's charm and true feelings.

cinevault.us.title: Swept Away
cinevault.us.description: Imagine being shipwrecked on a beautiful island -- with someone you really can't stand. A young soldier (Adriano Giannini) is cast adrift on an island with his employer, a rich, self-centered woman who is used to having her own way. Cut off from society, he reverses their roles, stripping her of pride and vanity and controlling her completely. Until, that is, she falls in love with him.

cinevault.us.title: Crazy in Alabama
cinevault.us.description: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

cinevault.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
cinevault.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

circlecountry.us.title: The Quick and the Dead
circlecountry.us.description: During World War II, a pair of sisters come to the aid of an American patrol unit that was taken prisoner by the Germans.

circlecountry.us.title: One-Eyed Jacks
circlecountry.us.description: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

circlecountry.us.title: Red Sun
circlecountry.us.description: A train carrying a Japanese delegation with a ceremonial sword for President Grant is robbed by bandits led by Link (Charles Bronson) and Gauche (Alain Delon). When Gauche double-crosses him and leaves him for dead, Link is ordered to team up with Kuroda Jubei (Toshirô Mifune), one of the ambassador's guards, who has a week to recover the sword or commit suicide. Hoping to find out from Gauche where the gang buried their spoils before Kuroda can kill him, Link tries to escape from the samurai.

circlecountry.us.title: McLintock!
circlecountry.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

circlecountry.us.title: There Was a Crooked Man
circlecountry.us.description: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

circlecountry.us.title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
circlecountry.us.description: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Cave Woman
circlecountry.us.description: Kate is missing as a big convention is meeting to decide where to hold their convention, she is stuck in a cave.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Kate Flat on Her Back
circlecountry.us.description: With Kate injured, Uncle Joe and the daughters must corner the convention.

classica.us.title: Verdi - Nabucco
classica.us.description: Das Orchester der Arena di Verona interpretiert Giuseppe Verdis dritte Oper „Nabucco" unter der Leitung des israelischen Dirigenten Daniel Oren. Das erfolgreiche Werk feierte seine Uraufführung im Jahr 1842 im Teatro alla Scala in Mailand.

classica.us.title: Berg - Klaviersonate, op. 1
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni spielt Alban Bergs Klaviersonate in h-Moll, Op. 1. Molteni begann mit sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er schloss das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung und Ehrennennung ab.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Letzte Sonate Op. 109, 110 & 111
classica.us.description: Seine drei letzten Sonaten widmet Beethoven den intimen Dynamiken der menschlichen Seele, die von Verzweiflung bis Verwandlung reichen. Im Film werden die Musikwerke mit Szenen in verlassenen Schlössern untermalt, die an Einsamkeit erinnern.

classica.us.title: The Galileo Project: Musik der Spheren

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

history.ca.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Spectacular Cons
history.ca.description: History is full of miracle cures, far-fetched products, and astonishing feats, but not all of them are legitimate; a miracle snake oil that cures all? A piece of the Brooklyn Bridge for sale? A marathon-winner who crosses the finish line without hardly breaking a sweat? These are the stories of some of history's most spectacular cons, each deception more unbelievable than the last.

history.ca.title: The UnXplained - Secrets of the Pyramids ᴺᵉʷ
history.ca.description: For millennia, cultures around the world built pyramids from Egypt and Sudan to Mexico, the Canary Islands and beyond; some were tombs, some were temples and some may have been aligned with the heavens or built above hidden chambers and underground complexes; but why did so many ancient people, separated by oceans and centuries, return to the same monumental shape? Were pyramids simply the most practical way to build toward the sky, or could they reveal a deeper pattern of sacred knowledge?

history.ca.description: Some disguises hide an individual, others conceal an entire operation; a CIA vaccination campaign masks a global manhunt for the world's most wanted terrorist, while a luxury Red Sea resort operated by Mossad becomes the unlikely front for a mission to smuggle thousands of Sudanese Jews to safety; in wartime Philippines, an American singer uses charm, talent, and deception to outwit occupying forces and help rescue hundreds of POWs.

ifc.us.title: Meet the Parents
ifc.us.description: Everything that can possibly go wrong for groom-to-be Greg Focker does. The problems begin with Greg's disastrous first meeting with his girlfriend's family -- most notably her intimidating father Jack Byrnes, and it's all downhill from there.

ifc.us.title: Meet the Fockers
ifc.us.description: Now that Greg Focker is "in" with his soon-to-be in-laws, Jack and Dina Byrnes, it looks like smooth sailing for him and his fiancée, Pam. But that's before Pam's parents meet Greg's parents, the Fockers. The hyper-relaxed Fockers and the tightly-wound Byrnes are woefully mismatched from the start, and no matter how hard Greg and Pam try, there is just no bringing their families together. This all adds up to a disastrously funny time of getting to know you.

The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team.

Part science lesson and part travelogue, the show not only tells viewers that they should help with energy conservation, it also explains why energy conservation is important. The young explorers featured on the show uncover the science behind sensible solutions to creating a healthy planet. But it's not all about science, there's craziness and laughter mixed in, because -- well -- learning should be fun.

But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters.

Upon arrival in Japan, the Arashikage teach him the ways of the ninja warrior while also providing him something he's been longing for: a home. However, when secrets from Snake Eyes' past are revealed, his honor and allegiance get tested -- even if that means losing the trust of those closest to him.

movies.us.title: Jackass: The Movie
movies.us.description: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

movies.us.title: Jackass: Number Two

Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (movie) - 2006

movies.us.title: Jackass 3
movies.us.description: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. (movie) - 2010

movies.us.title: Jackass Forever

movies.us.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
movies.us.description: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. nick.uk.title: The Thundermans - Cookie Mistake
nick.uk.description: After Phoebe chooses Billy to accompany her to their favourite cookie factory's exclusive tasting event, Max and Nora are determined to sneak in and get to the delicious treats first.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans - Save the Past Dance
nick.uk.description: Tired of hearing tales of Hiddenville's legendary mayor, the kids use a time machine to travel back 60 years to disprove the myths. But when they inadvertently alter the past, the effect is disastrous for their hometown.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Space Invaders, Part 1
nick.uk.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger learn that an astronaut has been taken hostage aboard the Space Station, and set off on a space rescue.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Space Invaders, Part 2
nick.uk.description: On the Space Station Captain Man and Kid Danger discover a little girl is the one who has taken the astronauts hostage. After realising the astronauts are doing experiments on bunnies, Captain Man and Kid Danger decide to help her.

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Shell-shock; The Amazing Coat Man
nick.uk.description: The twins and Marsupilamis save an egg from the Jaguar, which hatches into a baby crocodile. The Marsupilamis are helping people, and Callie wants to find out who the Amazing Coat Man hero is.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Smurfalicious Catfood
nick.uk.description: Smurfalicious Catfood: Annoyed that Azrael doesn't like his baking, Chef makes delicious cat food for him that makes him gentle. Gargamel sees an opportunity to make his mother kinder.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Wobbly Tooth; The Darkest Night
nick.uk.description: Bubble goes on an adventure with Firefly. Gargamel creates a switch that can turn off all the lights so that he can find the Smurf village.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Waffle Thief
nick.uk.description: Dwayne is a huge fan of Lily's waffles, but she refuses to make any more for him.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - The Thirteenth Dessert; Slithering Smurfs
nick.uk.description: In keeping with one of the Smurfs' traditions, Chef Smurf and Blossom need to find a thirteenth dessert for Christmas dinner. Bubble and Jokey are the worst babysitters. They have turned Baby Smurf into a snail.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Bubble Wrap; Chess Mate
nick.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - A Knight's Tail; Dreambomber
nick.uk.description: When Eleanor discovers there are no female knights, she hides in a suit of armour and enters a knight competition; Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - The Henry Winkler Episode; Paper Loves Potato
nick.uk.description: Rock, Paper and Scissors crash into Hollywood actor Henry Winkler's house, and they all go on a wacky adventure together. While trying to woo Pencil, Paper mistakenly ends up in a relationship he doesn't want with Potato.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Sandpaper's Workout Program / The Secret
nick.uk.description: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - J-LAD; Big Honey
nick.uk.description: LAD has a sleepover and in an effort to join in, Jack ends up making a promise that turns their night upside down. When Will's parents visit Canyon Valley, news of the sale of their bee farm sends the family into a big, honeying.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Caught Rubber-Handed/ And... Action!
nick.uk.description: Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house. They must hide his awful habits from their parents. Seeking closure on her favourite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Big Bro Theodore; No Putts, No Glory
nick.uk.description: When Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother, he tries to be a better role model for Alvin and Simon. Alvin tricks Theodore into believing he's great at mini golf, which backfires when Theo signs up for a tournament.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Chimpmania; Dad Jokes
nick.uk.description: Jeanette and the Chipmunks orchestrate a break-in at Bocarter's house to rescue a chimpanzee he keeps in a cage. Alvin is alarmed that Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes because he's not that funny.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Baby Boss
nick.uk.description: While Boss Baby is away, interim manager Staci must fend off three challenges -- from Pyg & Tam, OCB and Bug the Pug.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Boom Baby
nick.uk.description: Boss Baby discovers an old Mega Fat initiative called Project Boom that threatens to ruin baby rights everywhere.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Love Is in the Lair
nick.uk.description: Mrs Wong visits Secret Shores, threatening to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town. Max and Phoebe's plan to have Dr Colosso keep her quiet backfires in unexpected ways.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - She's All Splat
nick.uk.description: Max convinces Cherry to pretend they are dating to get discounts at her new workplace, Splat by Sea. Meanwhile, Chloe must choose between winning a quiz or supporting Billy's wish to join her team.

nick.uk.title: Nickelodeon Slimetime UK - Episode 6
nick.uk.description: Olympic Skateboarder Lola Tabling shows us her amazing skills at the skate park.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Tee Fore Two
nick.uk.description: Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - SQUIDINA AND THE BRAIN/DAY OF THE SNAIL
nick.uk.description: When Patrick leaves his brain at home, Squidina needs to work with it to find his body. When SpongeBob goes on a trip with his parents for a day, he asks Squidina to pet-sit Gary.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Family Vide-Oh No!/The Cool Uncle
nick.uk.description: Patrick and Squidina re-tape the family's home videos. Patrick spends a day with Cecil's brother.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Merry Christmas, Mr Plankton Part 1
nick.uk.description: When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Rock's Half Birthday; Cherry Picking
nick.uk.description: Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true. Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry-picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors; The Wish
nick.uk.description: Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Hush, Little Baby
nick.uk.description: An innocent trip to the library for toddler story hour sparks a turf war between babydom and Frederic Estes' Consortium of Ancients.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Merry Christmas, Mr Plankton Part 1 ᴺᵉʷ
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Patrick Star Show - Snowbound! A Star Family Christmas ᴺᵉʷ
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The Patrick Star Show follows everyone's favorite sea star at home with his family as he hosts an imaginary variety show that comes from the bizarre and hysterical depths of his own brain.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - It's a SpongeBob Christmas!
nickelodeonwest.us.description: SpongeBob inadvertently helps Plankton get all the citizens of Bikini Bottom on Santa's naughty list.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Shrek 2
nickelodeonwest.us.description: After returning from their honeymoon and showing home movies to their friends, Shrek and Fiona learn that her parents have heard that she has married her true love and wish to invite him to their kingdom, called Far Far Away. The catch is: Fiona's parents are unaware of the curse that struck their daughter and have assumed she married Prince Charming, not a 700-pound ogre with horrible hygiene and a talking donkey pal.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Yeti
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Phoebe is surprised to discover that she enjoys wearing mink; Ross confronts Emily, and she demands a divorce; Monica and Rachel are afraid of a hairy new neighbor, until they find out how handsome he is with his hair cut.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One Where Ross Moves In
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Personal habits clash when Ross moves in with Chandler and Joey; Phoebe dates a health inspector (Gregory Sporleder); Rachel schemes to get her new neighbor to ask her out on a date.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Thanksgiving Flashbacks
nickelodeonwest.us.description: As the gang digests Monica's huge Thanksgiving meal, everyone reminisces about their worst Thanksgiving ever.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Ross' Sandwich
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Ross becomes upset when someone at work takes his sandwich from the refrigerator and eats it; Joey finds himself in a mess when he tries to cover for Chandler and Monica's dating.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Gates Excitation
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Penny gets the opportunity to host Bill Gates at work when his company wants to partner with hers; Leonard, Koothrappali and Wolowitz do everything in their power to meet him; Sheldon thinks he is the victim of a prank.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Tenant Disassociation
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Leonard decides to run against Sheldon for president of the tenants' association; Bernadette encourages Wolowitz and Koothrappali to find the owner of a drone after they find it in the backyard.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Reclusive Potential
nickelodeonwest.us.description: A brilliant but reclusive scientist, Doctor Wolcott, invites Sheldon to his cabin in the middle of nowhere; Penny and Bernadette improvise after Amy doesn't like the tame bachelorette party they planned for her.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Comet Polarization
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Sheldon's comic book store experience changes when writer Neil Gaiman puts Stuart's store on the map; friendships are threatened when Koothrappali takes credit for Penny's astronomical discovery.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Monetary Insufficiency
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Sheldon goes to Las Vegas to win money for science; Penny and Bernadette take Amy wedding dress shopping, but her terrible choice entangles them in a web of lies.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Sibling Realignment
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Sheldon's mother won't attend his wedding unless he invites his brother; the Wolowitz kids inadvertently infest Amy, Bernadette, Wolowitz and Koothrappali with pink eye.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Inappropriate Sister
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Phoebe helps the Salvation Army and learns some truths about New Yorkers; Rachel gets a date with her neighbor who has a close relationship with his sexy sister; Joey tries to write a play in which he can be the star.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With All the Resolutions
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Ross vows to try something new; Joey resolves to learn guitar from Phoebe; Rachel gives up gossiping.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Chandler's Work Laugh
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Monica is put off by the laugh Chandler uses to impress his boss (Sam McMurray); Ross shocks everyone by dating Janice (Maggie Wheeler).

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Joey's Bag
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Phoebe meets her estranged father (Bob Balaban) at her grandmother's funeral; Joey's fondness for an expensive bag loses him an audition; Chandler tells perfectionist Monica that she is useless at massage.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One Where Everybody Finds Out
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Ross must prove to his boss that he is sane in order to return to work; Phoebe finds out about Monica and Chandler's relationship; Ross hunts for a new apartment.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Girl Who Hits Joey
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Chandler gets nervous when everyone learns about Monica; Joey's new girlfriend gets physical; Ross moves into a new apartment but fails to impress his new neighbors.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Cop
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Phoebe finds a police officer's badge and goes on a spree of arrests until she meets up with the owner; Joey thinks he's in love with Monica; Ross buys a couch but won't pay to have it delivered.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Rachel's Inadvertent Kiss
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel worries about a kiss she gives to a job interviewer; Monica observes Phoebe's romantic bliss; Joey is arrested for stalking a sexy neighbor.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - My Tighty Whiteys; What Ever Happened to Baby Prunes?
nickelodeonwest.us.description: SpongeBob goes on a search after his favorite pair of underwear goes missing; Baby Prunes shares the story of her days as a child star to explain why she despises chocolate.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Night School Knuckleheads; Painfully Employed
nickelodeonwest.us.description: At night school, SpongeBob and Patrick dive into a series of classes on wildly different subjects; Plankton hires Bubble Bass at the Chum Bucket and realizes he can utilize him to get his hands on a Krabby Patty.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington and the Three Musketeers
nickjr.uk.description: Paddington builds a robot in 'Paddington Meets PaddingTron', then in 'Paddington's First Diwali', Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him and Paddington is his helpful assistant.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt
nickjr.uk.description: Paddington has a race against time in 'Paddington and the Solar Eclipse', then in 'Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor', Simi receives an inventor's award, but why does she feel sad.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Journey into a Black Hole
nickjr.uk.description: The Browns go to the beach in 'Paddington's Summer Holiday Begins', then in 'Paddington's Life Guard Training', Paddington, Jonathan and Judy rescue Mr Brown with lifeguard Taylor's help.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Rainbow Race!
nickjr.uk.description: Something is making strange noises in 'Paddington's Mysterious Cave Discovery', and in 'Paddington and the Fossil Hunt', Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but isn't having any luck.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Happily Ever After
nickjr.uk.description: At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Singing Lesson
nickjr.uk.description: Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson, helped by Mummy Rhino on the piano. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Singing Competition
nickjr.uk.description: Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Larenzo Lion
nickjr.uk.description: Today, Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Larenzo Lion who lives there! Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dinosaurs Alive!
nickjr.uk.description: The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard! The children all believe it's a dinosaur.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Babies
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Cat's Cafe
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Cafe. Candy show Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cushion Den
nickjr.uk.description: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together.

nickjr.uk.title: Paw Patrol - Pups Save a Frozen Camp-Out
nickjr.uk.description: Alex and Mr. Porter are on a tropical Island camping trip when a freak snowstorm hits.

nickjr.uk.title: Paw Patrol - Pups Save the Fizzy Pickles
nickjr.uk.description: Mr. Porter is delivering his famous fizzy pickles to people around town when a bumpy road shakes up the deliveries and causes the pickle jars to pop.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington and the Lake Monster
nickjr.uk.description: Paddington helps Mateo dress up in 'Paddington and the Three Musketeers', then in 'Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt', Paddington, Simi and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt in the park.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Space Radio
nickjr.uk.description: Things go missing in Windsor Gardens in 'Paddington's Journey into a Black Hole', then in 'Paddington's Rainbow Race!', Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of rainbow.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Beach Stowaway
nickjr.uk.description: Judy loses a tooth in 'Paddington & The Tooth Fairy', then in 'Paddington Goes to Work', Paddington becomes a work bear and helps Mr. Brown at home, but learns computers can be tricky.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Happy Parky
nickjr.uk.description: When a storm keeps the Rexes at home they must think of a game to pass the time.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Treasure
nickjr.uk.description: Tim, Tommy, Tia and Grandma go on the search for treasure.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Rumblefest Eve
nickjr.uk.description: When the Rumblefest tree for Rumblefest Eve is nowhere to be seen, Tim must find a way to save the day.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Lucy's Picnic
nickjr.uk.description: On a tour of the Elf Factory, the Elf and Fairy children learn about recycling and see how rubbish is re-used. When the factory runs out of material, they set out to find some more.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Nature Class
nickjr.uk.description: Nanny Plum takes the Fairy children for a nature class in the woods, and bumps into the Wise Old Elf who is teaching a nature class to the Elf children.

nickjr.uk.title: Stan & Gran - Bananas at Dawn
nickjr.uk.description: Grumblestunk is sure she saw an enormous banana when she walked Stink on the beach early that morning and Stan and Gran spy a mystery - but no banana.

nickjr.uk.title: Stan & Gran - The Big Spot
nickjr.uk.description: A giant albatross is seen near Porthole and Stan has to spot it! But the bird's footprints are bigger than any real albatross. What's going on.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Stop the Garboni
nickjr.uk.description: Pups rescue Ace and Skye from a stuck plane in 'Pups and the Ace of Skies', then in 'Pups Save the Babysitter', Priya saves the pups at the farm.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Pups and the Ace of the Skies
nickjr.uk.description: The Pups save a new water park in 'Pups Save Splashy Bottom', then in 'Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide', Pups save ancient relics at the Museum.

nickjr.uk.title: Deer Squad
nickjr.uk.description: Chitter upgrades the Forest Flyer in 'The Forest Flyer Flies', then in 'Scary Prankster', Trickalien shows Lola how to be funny.

nickjr.uk.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Demolishes A Rock Mountain
nickjr.uk.description: Speed Meister sabotages a speeding train, accidentally sending it towards a huge mountain! Rubble & Crew use their demolition vehicles to save the day.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Splashy Bottom
nickjr.uk.description: The pups hunt at the Farm Fair in 'Pups Save the Farm Festival', while in 'Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay', Rocky dreams of a sudsy adventure.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Porcupine
nickjr.uk.description: Farmer Al's new machine goes haywire in 'Pups Stop the Garboni', then in 'Pups Save the Porcupine', the Paw Patrol catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

nickjr.uk.title: Deer Squad
nickjr.uk.description: Monster cakes go on a city rampage in 'Cake-Astrophe', then in 'Solar Storm Scramble', Bobbi has to stop an asteroid crisis.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Space Bug
nickjr.uk.description: Tim and Kai try to photograph the elusive SpaceBug.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Explorer
nickjr.uk.description: Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Tickets
nickjr.uk.description: Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket.

nickjr.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Dollhouse Safari
nickjr.uk.description: Gabby, Pandy and their curious crew set out on an animal safari. Can they work together to find a mysterious creature? Let the adventure begin.

nickjr.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Charm Bracelet Treasure Hunt
nickjr.uk.description: Gabby unboxes a charm bracelet that has a tiny bottle charm with a treasure map inside! Following the clues on the map, we find more charms for the bracelet.

nickjr.uk.title: The Smurfs - Smurfs At Sea
nickjr.uk.description: Smurfette accidentally loses the Smurf Village in 'Wanna Bet?', then in 'Gargamel, Queen of the Prom', the Smurf Girls invite all the Smurfs to their Grand Equinox Ball.

nickjr.uk.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Pirate Ship Café
nickjr.uk.description: The pups turn a house into a houseboat in 'The Crew Builds A Houseboat', and then in 'The Crew Builds A Spa', the crew give Auntie Crane a spa day.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - All Paws on Deck
nickjr.uk.description: Ryder calls on every member of the Paw Patrol to stop a hi-tech kid inventor from demolishing Adventure Bay so she can build her own dream city in its place.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Big BBQ
nickjr.uk.description: Adventure Bay is getting a Fire Station! When disaster strikes during the opening day barbecue, it's up to the Paw Patrol to put it out.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Skye's Road Trip Rescue
nickjr.uk.description: Skye, Liberty and Everest head off on a road trip in a cool new RV. But then a baby moose, rabbit and bear go missing. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2013

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Once Upon a Time
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and family go on a walk through the forests where they meet all their favourite fairytale characters. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - London
nickjr.uk.description: Madame Gazelle takes the whole class to London for the day and get a tour by The Queen herself. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Ambulance
nickjr.uk.description: Dr. Brown Bear comes to visit the playgroup and teach all of the children what to do when there's been an accident. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Suzy Goes Away
nickjr.uk.description: Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Skate Park
nickjr.uk.description: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the Skate Park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Little Swift
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Undersea Party

Left with no alternative, Anderson enlists the help of a group of local schoolboys. But when he finds that his future boss has been gunned down, he's forced to find work elsewhere. Despite his sexist attitudes, Rocklin charms the fiery Arly with his cavalier bravado and lands a job at her family's ranch. Helping Roy defend his livelihood is sultry saloon girl Cherry Malotte (Marlene Dietrich), whom McNamara also lusts after. These conflicts of interest will likely get settled in the usual way: an epic saloon brawl.

Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

pop.us.title: Grumpy Old Men
pop.us.description: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend.

pop.us.title: Grumpier Old Men
pop.us.description: Elderly, angling and contentious friends Max (Walter Matthau) and John (Jack Lemmon) back-burner their bickering when their kids (Kevin Pollak, Daryl Hannah) get engaged, but fishing season opens a can of romantic worms as newcomer Maria (Sophia Loren) plans to turn their beloved bait shop into a restaurant. Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love.

pop.us.title: Practical Magic
pop.us.description: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line. (movie) - 1998

Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid.

Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate.

retroplex.us.title: Lightning Raiders
retroplex.us.description: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains.

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass

screenpix.us.title: Scissors
screenpix.us.description: In the wake of a brutal assault suffered at the hands of a red-bearded stranger, Angie Anderson (Sharon Stone) is grappling with her own sanity. To heal her scarred psyche, her therapist (Ronny Cox) urges hypnotherapy, which causes her to face gruesome truths from her past. Not long after getting entangled in a sordid love triangle with twin brothers, Alex (Steve Railsback) and Cole (also Railsback), Angie is lured into a twisted trap that threatens to unravel what little sanity she has left.

screenpix.us.title: The Vampire
screenpix.us.description: A small-town doctor (John Beal) cannot stop taking the pills that turn him into a fanged killer.

screenpix.us.title: Black Sabbath
screenpix.us.description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

screenpix.us.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
screenpix.us.description: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. So they consult local vet Dr. Robert Hansen (William Shatner), who becomes puzzled and calls in scientist Diane Ashley (Tiffany Bolling). Eventually, the duo discovers that oversize spiders are invading the small town, putting the entire population in danger as a county fair begins.

screenpix.us.title: Die, Monster, Die!
screenpix.us.description: Scientist Stephen Reinhart travels to a small town where he plans to visit his fiancée Susan Witley and meet her parents. Oddly, when he arrives, the townspeople are unfriendly. At Susan's parents' estate, her father, Nahum, is acting suspiciously and her mother, Letitia, is hidden away in a bedroom. When Stephen and Susan begin investigating the strange behavior in town, they realize that a radioactive meteor is to blame.

screenpix.us.title: The Coca-Cola Kid
screenpix.us.description: Becker (Eric Roberts) is an American marketing expert working for the Coca-Cola Company. He is extremely dedicated to his work and travels the world pushing the product on as many places as he can. When he realizes that there is a part of Australia where absolutely nobody buys Coke, he vows to change that. But then he meets not only McDowell (Bill Kerr), a local entrepreneur who manufactures his own soda, but McDowell's beautiful daughter, Terri (Greta Scacchi), and everything changes.

screenpix.us.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
screenpix.us.description: This screen adaptation of the stage musical of the same name finds the Roman slave Pseudolus scheming his way to freedom by playing matchmaker for his master's son, Hero, who is smitten with the blonde and beautiful Philia. However, things don't go at all according to plan. The complications that ensue involve blackmail, funny disguises and long-lost children, while Pseudolus desperately tries to keep up with his end of the bargain.

screenpix.us.title: Flight From Ashiya
screenpix.us.description: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

screenpix.us.title: The Sultan's Daughter
screenpix.us.description: An American woos the daughter (Ann Corio) of an Arab (Charles Butterworth) who's defending his oil fields from Germans.

screenpix.us.title: The Ape
screenpix.us.description: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan. (movie) - 1940
