starzedge.us.title: Something New
starzedge.us.description: Career-minded Kenya McQueen is set up on a blind date with architect Brian Kelly, but backs out when she realizes that he is white. Impressed with his work on a friend's mansion, McQueen hires Kelly to design her new garden -- and he sweeps her off her feet. But, after her friends introduce her to executive Mark Harper, McQueen must choose between the type of man she always dreamed she wanted and giving in to life's little surprises.

starzedge.us.title: American Gangster
starzedge.us.description: Frank Lucas earns his living as a chauffeur to one of Harlem's leading mobsters. After his boss dies, Frank uses his own ingenuity and strict business code to become one of the inner city's most powerful crime bosses. Veteran cop Richie Roberts senses a change in the mob's power structure and looks for ways to bring his opponent to justice.

starzedge.us.title: Oscar Shaw
starzedge.us.description: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected.

starzedge.us.title: Closing the Ring
starzedge.us.description: During the 1940s, a group of young men go off to war, leaving behind Ethel Ann (Mischa Barton), who is in love with one of them, Teddy. In modern-day Belfast, a man named Jimmy (Martin McCann) endeavors to return a ring found in the wreckage of a crashed plane. He travels to Michigan, where the grown Ethel Ann (Shirley MacLaine), who married another man after Teddy was killed in battle, now lives. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive.

starzedge.us.title: Tracks
starzedge.us.description: Accompanied only by her faithful dog and four camels, an Australian (Mia Wasikowska) satisfies her craving for solitude by embarking on a solo trip across the desert from Alice Springs to the Indian Ocean.

starzedge.us.title: Pixels
starzedge.us.description: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

starzedge.us.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
starzedge.us.description: After a gentle alien becomes stranded on Earth, the being is discovered and befriended by a young boy named Elliott. Bringing the extraterrestrial into his suburban California house, Elliott introduces E.T., as the alien is dubbed, to his brother and his little sister, Gertie, and the children decide to keep its existence a secret. Soon, however, E.T. falls ill, resulting in government intervention and a dire situation for both Elliott and the alien.

starzedge.us.title: Oblivion
starzedge.us.description: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind. (movie) - 2013

starzedge.us.title: Closing the Ring
starzedge.us.description: During the 1940s, a group of young men go off to war, leaving behind Ethel Ann (Mischa Barton), who is in love with one of them, Teddy. In modern-day Belfast, a man named Jimmy (Martin McCann) endeavors to return a ring found in the wreckage of a crashed plane. He travels to Michigan, where the grown Ethel Ann (Shirley MacLaine), who married another man after Teddy was killed in battle, now lives. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive. (movie) - 2007

starzedge.us.title: The Break-Up
starzedge.us.description: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates. (movie) - 2006

starzencore.us.title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
starzencore.us.description: Thirty years after the defeat of the Galactic Empire, the galaxy faces a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren (Adam Driver) and the First Order. When a defector named Finn crash-lands on a desert planet, he meets Rey (Daisy Ridley), a tough scavenger whose droid contains a top-secret map. Together, the young duo joins forces with Han Solo (Harrison Ford) to make sure the Resistance receives the intelligence concerning the whereabouts of Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), the last of the Jedi Knights.

starzencore.us.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
starzencore.us.description: When Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) jump-starts a dormant peacekeeping program, things go terribly awry, forcing him, Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the Incredible Hulk (Mark Ruffalo) and the rest of the Avengers to reassemble. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff.

starzencore.us.title: Ant-Man
starzencore.us.description: Forced out of his own company by former protégé Darren Cross, Dr. Hank Pym recruits the talents of Scott Lang, a master thief just released from prison. Lang becomes Ant-Man, trained by Pym and armed with a suit that allows him to shrink in size, possess superhuman strength and control an army of ants. The miniature hero must use his new skills to prevent Cross, also known as Yellowjacket, from perfecting the same technology and using it as a weapon for evil.

starzencore.us.title: Priest
starzencore.us.description: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills.

starzencore.us.title: Surfer, Dude
starzencore.us.description: Steve Addington is a professional surfer and beach bum who lives to ride the waves. Since there are suddenly no good waves in the ocean, Addington must reconsider Zarno's offer and ponder his place in the world. Struggling with the choice, Addington seeks advice from his friends.

starzencore.us.title: The Perfect Holiday
starzencore.us.description: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

starzencoreaction.us.title: 47 Meters Down
starzencoreaction.us.description: Young sisters Kate and Lisa and travel to Mexico for a vacation filled with sun, fun and adventure. Lisa needs some extra persuasion when Kate suggests that they go diving in shark-infested waters. Safe in their protective cage, the thrill-seeking siblings come face to face with a group of majestic great whites. Their worst fears soon become a reality when the cage breaks away from their boat, sending them plummeting to the ocean floor with a dwindling supply of oxygen.

starzencoreaction.us.title: 47 Meters Down: Uncaged
starzencoreaction.us.description: Four teenage divers discover that the sunken ruins of a Mayan city are also a hunting ground for deadly great white sharks. With their air supply steadily dwindling, the frightened girls must navigate the underwater labyrinth of claustrophobic caves and eerie tunnels in search of a way out of their watery hell.

starzencoreaction.us.title: The Furious
starzencoreaction.us.description: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network, his only ally is Navin, a journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo finds themselves in an explosive martial-arts showdown against a relentless gang of thugs.

starzencoreaction.us.title: Goon: Last of the Enforcers
starzencoreaction.us.description: A lockout has reunited old teammates and brought a crew of new players to the bench for the Halifax Highlanders. Sidelined after one too many hits and now married with a baby on the way, Doug "The Thug" Glatt hangs up his skates and settles into life as an insurance salesman. But when Doug's nemesis, Anders Cain, is made captain of the Highlanders and new ownership threatens to tear his team apart, Doug is compelled back into action.

starzencoreblack.us.description: A collection of funny, poignant, romantic and suspenseful stories that look at the ways in which we have adapted to a new pandemic world.

starzencoreblack.us.title: The Defender
starzencoreblack.us.description: A bodyguard (Dolph Lundgren) battles an unknown attacker who has ambushed a secret meeting between an American official and a terrorist.

starzencoreblack.us.title: A Girl Like Grace
starzencoreblack.us.description: Seventeen-year-old Grace (Ryan Destiny) has been raised by her single mother (Garcelle Beauvais), Lisa, in a rather dysfunctional environment. As she yearns for acceptance in the world, Grace finds herself bullied at school by Mary (Raven-Symoné). She seeks guidance from her best friend Andrea (Paige Hurd) and Share, Andrea's older sister.

starzencoreblack.us.title: Apple Mortgage Cake
starzencoreblack.us.description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

starzencoreblack.us.title: Undercover Brother
starzencoreblack.us.description: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash. (movie) - 2002

starzencoreblack.us.title: Motives
starzencoreblack.us.description: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox). (movie) - 2004

starzencoreblack.us.title: Motives 2: Retribution
starzencoreblack.us.description: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore). (movie) - 2007

starzencoreblack.us.title: Apple Mortgage Cake
starzencoreblack.us.description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days. (movie) - 2014

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Last Chance Harvey
starzencoreclassic.us.description: In London for his daughter's wedding, a struggling jingle-writer, Harvey Shine (Dustin Hoffman), misses his plane to New York, and thus loses his job. While drowning his sorrows in the airport pub, Harvey meets Kate (Emma Thompson), a British government worker stuck in an endless cycle of work, phone calls from her mother, and blind dates. A connection forms between the unhappy pair, who soon find themselves falling in love.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: No Strings Attached
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Lethal Ninja
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A former CIA agent (Ross Kettle) heads to Africa to save his scientist wife (Karyn Hill) from a killer holding her captive.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: These Girls
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Before heading off to college, a teenager (Caroline Dhavernas) and her two friends try to seduce a married man (David Boreanaz).

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Thirty years after the defeat of the Galactic Empire, the galaxy faces a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren (Adam Driver) and the First Order. starzencoreclassic.us.title: Still Waiting ...
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When a competing eatery steals their customers, restaurant employees hatch a raunchy plan to drum up business.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Permanent Midnight
starzencoreclassic.us.description: As television writer Jerry Stahl (Ben Stiller) becomes more successful, his heroin habit grows worse. Already using when he comes to Los Angeles, Stahl finds his problems intensify when he moves in with his friend Nicky (Owen Wilson), also an addict. Eventually, Stahl marries producer Sandra (Elizabeth Hurley) to help her get a green card, and she gets him jobs on top television shows. However, more and more, he is unable to separate his addiction from his working life. (movie) - 1998

starzencorefamily.us.description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

starzencorefamily.us.title: Failure to Launch
starzencorefamily.us.description: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

starzencorefamily.us.title: Bandslam
starzencorefamily.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

starzencorefamily.us.title: Wickensburg
starzencorefamily.us.description: When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret.

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Dog Who Saved Summer
starzencorefamily.us.description: After their dog Zeus ruins a party, George takes him to an obedience school run by a no-nonsense instructor. When Zeus manages to fail every test, he seeks help from a trainer with special techniques.

starzencorefamily.us.title: Midnight Sun
starzencorefamily.us.description: Sheltered since childhood, 17-year-old Katie Price lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight. Her world opens up after dark when she ventures out to play her guitar for random travelers. One night, Katie encounters Charlie, a young man she's secretly admired for years. As fate leads to a budding romance, Katie desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

starzencorefamily.us.title: House of D
starzencorefamily.us.description: In the present, artist Tom Warshaw recalls his traumatic coming of age. As a 13-year-old growing up in New York City in 1973, Tom hangs out with Pappass, a mentally disabled man. With Tom's mother battling depression after the death of her husband, the young boy is left to his own devices. When Tom develops a crush on schoolmate Melissa, Pappass feels abandoned and begins behaving erratically.

starzencorefamily.us.title: Cricket & Antoinette
starzencorefamily.us.description: Cricket and Antoinette represent two separate worlds, the world of noise, chaos and creativity, and the world of work, order and discipline; as they fall in love, in spite of obvious differences, they manage to create harmony.

starzencorewesterns.us.description: Bart and his gambling buddy fight over the love of a beautiful dancer.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Stranger on Horseback
starzencorewesterns.us.description: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: The Unforgiven
starzencorewesterns.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Pancho Villa
starzencorewesterns.us.description: This mostly fictional account follows the trigger-happy Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa (Telly Savalas) in his attempt to kill bitter nemesis Gen. Goyo and overthrow Mexico's government. The violent endeavor brings Villa north to New Mexico, where he battles a group of determined American soldiers led by the no-nonsense Col. Wilcox (Chuck Connors), and endures unanticipated mishaps and bad fortune, including a double-cross by his friend and partner, Scotty (Clint Walker).

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Hostiles
starzencorewesterns.us.description: In 1892, legendary Army Capt. Joseph Blocker reluctantly agrees to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal land. Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outlaws.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
starzencorewesterns.us.description: A cowboy escorts a young half-Native American girl, whose mother has recently died. He must find her white father in order to claim her hefty inheritance.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads. (movie) - 1939

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Along the Navajo Trail
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Gypsies help a U.S. deputy marshal (Roy Rogers) pose as a singing drifter and bust an oil syndicate. (movie) - 1945

starzinblack.us.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
starzinblack.us.description: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You."

starzinblack.us.title: Michael
starzinblack.us.description: The journey of pop star Michael Jackson, from his early days to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

starzinblack.us.title: Premium
starzinblack.us.description: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

starzinblack.us.title: Saturday Church
starzinblack.us.description: Ulysses is a shy and effeminate boy who finds himself coping with new responsibilities as man of the house after the death of his father. Living alongside his mother, younger brother, and conservative aunt, Ulysses is also struggling with questions about his gender identity. He finds an escape by creating a world of fantasy filled with dance and music. Ulysses' journey takes a turn for the better when he finds a vibrant transgender community.

starzinblack.us.title: The Last Face
starzinblack.us.description: Miguel (Javier Bardem), a Spanish doctor, puts himself in harm's way to deliver medical treatment to the victims of military uprisings. Wren (Charlize Theron) is the spokesperson for an organization that funds medical assistance for impoverished nations the world over. They meet in Liberia, where Wren is immediately impressed with Miguel's selflessness, medical skill and charm. They begin a torrid affair, one they must learn to balance with their important work.

starzinblack.us.title: First Sunday
starzinblack.us.description: Petty thieves Durell and LeeJohn face a big problem: The two must come up with $17,000 in one week, or Durell will no longer be able to see his son. The goofy scoundrels embark on a haphazard plan to rob the neighborhood church, but they find the mission trickier than expected. When they arrive, they discover that somebody equally disreputable has already had his hand in the coffers. Now, they must trace the money to a group of parishioners.

starzinblack.us.title: The Bounce Back
starzinblack.us.description: Relationship expert Matthew Taylor (Shemar Moore) is on a book tour promoting his bestseller "The Bounce Back" when he meets talk show circuit therapist Kristin Peralta (Nadine Velazquez), who calls him out as a fraud. Matthew's life is upended when, in spite of himself, he falls in love with this quick-witted woman and is forced to face painful truths about a past relationship.

starzinblack.us.title: The Details
starzinblack.us.description: Seemingly blind to the actual cracks in his marriage, a doctor (Tobey Maguire) blames a family of destructive raccoons for the problems in his home life. (movie) - 2011

starzinblack.us.title: What Men Want
starzinblack.us.description: Passed up for a well-deserved promotion, sports agent Ali Davis wonders what else she needs to do to succeed in a man's world. Hoping to find answers from a psychic, Ali drinks a weird concoction that suddenly allows her to hear what men are thinking. Using her newfound ability, Ali starts to turn the tables on her obnoxious male colleagues while racing to sign the next basketball superstar. (movie) - 2019

starzkids&family.us.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
starzkids&family.us.description: After a gentle alien becomes stranded on Earth, the being is discovered and befriended by a young boy named Elliott. Bringing the extraterrestrial into his suburban California house, Elliott introduces E.T., as the alien is dubbed, to his brother and his little sister, Gertie, and the children decide to keep its existence a secret. Soon, however, E.T. falls ill, resulting in government intervention and a dire situation for both Elliott and the alien.

starzkids&family.us.title: Oddball
starzkids&family.us.description: A chicken farmer and his granddaughter train a dog to protect a penguin sanctuary from foxes.

starzkids&family.us.title: Measure of a Man
starzkids&family.us.description: A teen develops a bond with a Wall Street executive while learning to stand up to bullies during one life-changing summer.

starzkids&family.us.title: Turtle Tale
starzkids&family.us.description: Rafi, Hank and Goliath, a trio of talking turtles, are living the good life at a Florida animal park. But when vandals kidnap Hank, it's up to Rafi and Goliath to find their missing friend.

starzkids&family.us.title: Jurassic Park
starzkids&family.us.description: In Steven Spielberg's massive blockbuster, paleontologists Alan Grant (Sam Neill) and Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and mathematician Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) are among a select group chosen to tour an island theme park populated by dinosaurs created from prehistoric DNA. While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt. (movie) - 1993

starzkids&family.us.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
starzkids&family.us.description: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait. (movie) - 1997

starzkids&family.us.title: Jurassic Park III
starzkids&family.us.description: After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives. (movie) - 2001

starzwest.us.description: Henry ventures off to procure gemstones; Julia finds a way to get back in Lovat's good graces; Brian returns to Leathers to settle a score with his father.

starzwest.us.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood - The Dance
starzwest.us.description: Julia and Lovat attend an event honoring Loyalist Lairds who fought against Jacobites in the Rebellion; Ellen's longstanding plan to protect Leoch from the Crown is put to the test.

starzwest.us.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood - Another Man's Shadow

starzwest.us.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles - Hard Exit

starzwest.us.description: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

starzwest.us.title: Adam Sandler's Eight Crazy Nights
starzwest.us.description: Davey Stone, a 33-year-old party animal, finds himself in trouble with the law after his wild ways go too far. In keeping with the holiday spirit, the judge gives Davey one last chance at redemption, spend the holiday performing community service as the assistant referee for the youth basketball league or go to jail. Davey thinks he's gotten off easy until he meets Whitey Duvall, the eccentric, elf-like head referee. (movie) - 2002

starzwest.us.title: Black Nativity
starzwest.us.description: Langston (Jacob Latimore), a Baltimore teen raised by a single mother (Jennifer Hudson), travels to New York City to spend the Christmas holiday with estranged relatives, the Rev. Cornell Cobbs (Forest Whitaker) and his wife, Aretha (Angela Bassett). However, Langston soon finds that Cobbs has strict rules, and the youth is unwilling to follow them. Instead, he sets out on a return journey to his mother and finds the value of faith, healing and family along the way. (movie) - 2013

stvnorth.uk.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E3 Josie Gibson and the team are in Brighton helping Dan, whose home has been taken over by his fiancee's stash of vintage treasures. Natacha used to run an online vintage shop, but since the arrival of their baby everything has been put on hold. As a result, one room is now full of old stock and new dad Dan wants it gone to create a bedroom for their daughter. Tensions run high when all is revealed - is the offer big enough to entice Natacha to take the cash.

stvnorth.uk.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E4 Josie Gibson, Dan Hatfield and Jacqueline McLeod help Tim, who wants to sell items his girlfriend Sally has spent a lifetime collecting. While Sally is shopping in London, Josie and the team rummage through her many unique items. Arriving home to discover her treasures have been boxed up and valued, will Sally keep her collections or take the cash.

stvnorth.uk.title: Barry Humphries: The Last Laugh
stvnorth.uk.description: A profile of the comedy writer and performer, taking an upbeat and honest look back at the life and work of the trailblazer behind Dame Edna Everage and Sir Les Patterson. Barry's friends including Nick Cave, Jason Donovan, Jonathan Ross, Sharon Osbourne and Alison Hammond pay tribute to a man who proved as complex as he was funny.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E4 Edinburgh James and his companion Tom Kitchin head to Edinburgh, but first they take a detour to a whisky distillery in Pitlochry, where James knocks up whisky chicken with wild mushroom and mustard sauce. Once they reach the capital, Tom shares his knowledge of the local fish, James gets fitted for a kilt and learns the history of the iconic garment, and the pair enjoy a bite to eat at Tom's Michelin-starred restaurant.

stvnorth.uk.title: Die Another Day
stvnorth.uk.description: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

stvnorth.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E6 Pub Lunch Clodagh McKenna hosts a fun make-ahead lunch for family and friends in the Cork Arms, the pub in her garden. She welcomes her guests with an Irish-inspired half a pint of prawns served in glasses with homemade mayonnaise, then serves up a crowd-pleasing pie with chicken and ham, and a no-cook cheeseboard with a delicious spread of cheeses, fruit, nuts and crackers.

sundancetv.us.title: Rocky V
sundancetv.us.description: Recently retired boxer Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) falls on hard times after his accountant mismanages his finances. He stages a comeback of sorts by mentoring fiery young boxer Tommy (Tommy Morrison), while also trying to mend his shaky relationship with his own son, Robert (Sage Stallone). These challenges prove to be at least as tough as any fight Rocky has faced in the ring. He wonders if he will be able to meet them and raise his arms in victory again.

sundancetv.us.title: Rocky Balboa
sundancetv.us.description: Now long-retired, Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) runs a Philadelphia eatery and mourns the loss of his beloved wife, Adrian. Yearning to recapture a bit of his glory days, he plans to re-enter the ring for a few low-profile, local matches. All that changes when Rocky accepts a challenge to fight the world's reigning heavyweight champion, Mason "the Line" Dixon (Antonio Tarver).

sundancetv.us.title: Rocky
sundancetv.us.description: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone), a small-time boxer from working-class Philadelphia, is arbitrarily chosen to take on the reigning world heavyweight champion, Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers), when the undefeated fighter's scheduled opponent is injured. While training with feisty former bantamweight contender Mickey Goldmill (Burgess Meredith), Rocky tentatively begins a relationship with Adrian (Talia Shire), the wallflower sister of his meat-packer pal Paulie (Burt Young). syfy.us.description: A man makes a deal with a mischievous elf who casts a magic spell that brings the 12 Days of Christmas to life.

syfy.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
syfy.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch.

syfywest.us.description: Michael Newman seems to have it all but his wife, Donna, is increasingly frustrated by the amount of time he has to spend at work. Michael cannot find time to be at home until he meets an eccentric inventor who gives him a universal remote that controls time. At first, he happily skips the boring times until he realizes the remote is in control of his life, and he learns to cherish all the precious moments with his family.

syfywest.us.description: An unscrupulous traveling salesman sells some magic dust he claims will save a man due to hang for killing a little girl during a drunken spree.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Passage on the Lady Anne
syfywest.us.description: A woman hopes a trans-Atlantic cruise and holiday in London will help save her marriage.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Whole Truth
syfywest.us.description: The disreputable patter of a used-car dealer changes when he buys a haunted car from an old man and finds he is suddenly unable to lie to his customers.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - No Time Like the Past
syfywest.us.description: A man (Dana Andrews) travels backward in time and tries to change events surrounding Hiroshima, Hitler and the Lusitania.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Twenty-Two
syfywest.us.description: A young woman complains of a recurring nightmare in which she always ends up in Room 22 - the hospital morgue.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Nervous Man in a Four-Dollar Room
syfywest.us.description: A small-time thief sees a new reflection of himself in a mirror. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller) - 1960-10-14

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Four O'Clock
syfywest.us.description: An obsessed Oliver Crangle (Theodore Bikel) tells an FBI agent that a drastic transformation will take place on all the evil people in the world. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller) - 1962-04-06

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Mr. Bevis
syfywest.us.description: A happy-go-lucky man loses his job, gets evicted and wrecks his car, all in one day. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller) - 1960-06-03

syfywest.us.title: Click
syfywest.us.description: Michael Newman seems to have it all but his wife, Donna, is increasingly frustrated by the amount of time he has to spend at work. Michael cannot find time to be at home until he meets an eccentric inventor who gives him a universal remote that controls time. At first, he happily skips the boring times until he realizes the remote is in control of his life, and he learns to cherish all the precious moments with his family. (movie) - 2006

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Strange Case of Sherlock... - ...Holmes and Arthur Conan Doyle. 2005. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Cilla Ware. Stars Douglas Henshall, Brian Cox & Emily Blunt. The story of Conan Doyle's remarkable life and the birth of Sherlock Holmes.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Ghosts on the Loose
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1943. Comedy. Stars Bela Lugosi & Ava Gardner. The East Side Kids try to fix up a house for newlyweds, but find the place next door 'haunted' by mysterious men.

talkingpictures.uk.title: 1960s London - Glimpses
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1960s Life in England we particularly look at London in this great montage of clips from more of our favourite 1960s films along with remembering the fashions the songs the cars and the music.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Vise
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Serpent Beneath. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Zena Marshall. A renowned playwright becomes stale so he steals the play of an unknown author which gets him involved in complications.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Puzzles Are Coming
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Puzzles are Coming. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Puzzler tries to fool Knab while the Dynamic Duo hunt the truth, but The Puzzler plans to stop their search.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Duo Is Slumming
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Duo is Slumming. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & William Dozier. The Puzzler is trying to hijack Knab's plane and hold it for ransom, but Batman and Robin find clues left behind.

talkingpictures.uk.title: I Lived With You - 1933. Drama. Stars
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ursula Jeans, Ida Lupino & Minnie Rayner. A penniless Russian Prince is befriended by Gladys who takes him home to live with her folks. Co-written by Ivor Novello.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scotland Yard - The Dover Road Mystery
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1960. The Dover Road Mystery. Directed by Gerard Bryant. Starring Geoffrey Keen, Edward Cast and Leonard Sachs. A stolen car used in a bank robbery proves too fast for the squad car.

talkingpictures.uk.title: William Tell - The Killer. 1959. Stars
talkingpictures.uk.description: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Accused of murdering a partisan helper and stealing his gold, Tell must find a way to prove his innocence.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Object Z - The World in Fear
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Brandon Brady & Terence Donovan. The British public begin to build shelters. Meanwhile in Australia, a 1000 mega ton bomb is launched at Object Z.

talkingpictures.uk.title: William at the Circus
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lost Cinema Serial - 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William attempts to raise money to ensure all the boys can go on a trip to London to visit Downing Street.

talkingpictures.uk.title: There Was An Old Woman Who Lived In A Shoe
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1940. A wonderful animated short film directed by George Pal featuring a twist on the classic nursery rhyme.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans - The Morristown Story
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & George Barnes. Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lone Ranger - The Renegades. 1949. Stars
talkingpictures.uk.description: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Gene Roth. While on the trail, Tonto gets an urgent message to meet Chief Swift Eagle.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Supercar - Trapped in the Depths
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. The US Navy are testing a new bathyscaphe when disaster strikes. The Supercar team spring into action to save the trapped crew.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - The Mystery of Ireland's Eye
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Eddie Byrne & Nigel Davenport. Robin and Friar Tuck escort Marian to Ireland to search for her uncle and encounter a monstrous priest.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Zontar - Thing From Venus
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1967. Sci-fi. Directed by Larry Buchanan. Stars John Agar, Susan Bjurman & Tony Huston. A young scientist believes an alien from Venus can help Earth but soon discovers it has a malevolent plan.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Blue Lamp
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1949. Crime. Directed by Basil Dearden. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Jack Warner & Jimmy Hanley. A killer shoots a London policeman during a robbery. (Action, Crime, Thriller, Movie) - 1950

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scales of Justice
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Company of Fools. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Barrie Ingham. Five strangers band together to exact revenge on a man who ruined them financially. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1983

talkingpictures.uk.title: Three Coins in the Fountain - 1954. Romantic Comedy. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jean Negulesco. Stars Dorothy McGuire & Jean Peters. Three women toss coins into Rome's Trevi Fountain for luck in romance. But none have the luck they hoped for. (Movie)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Caught in the Cold
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1963. A look at the chaos brought in by ice and snow each year in Britain, why it happens in an age of scientific miracles and what is being done about it. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin - The Hanging
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Jennie Linden. Turpin and Swiftnick try to help a mysterious woman who is being blackmailed by Captain Spiker, but they are led into a trap. (Comedy, Drama, Entertainment) - 1979

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
tastemade.us.description: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne
tastemade.us.description: Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta
tastemade.us.description: Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
tastemade.us.description: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie's ULTIMATE Autumn Garden FEAST!
tastemade.us.description: Jamie kicks off autumn with Italian-inspired cheesy cabbage pasta and smoky sweetcorn burgers with feta. He shares tips for storing onions and saving tomato seeds, finishing with a beautiful tomato galette for a perfect fall meal.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
tastemade.us.description: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company
tastemade.us.description: Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Benton's Famous Tennessee Hams
tastemade.us.description: Jess loves country hams and there's no better place to visit than Benton's--a family-run business that's been perfecting curing and aging techniques for over 50 years.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Cylon Rolling Acres Goat Birria Tacos
tastemade.us.description: Jess pitches in at Cylon Rolling Acres as owner Leslie Svacina runs her direct-to-consumer goat meat business.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch
tastemade.us.description: Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll
tastemade.us.description: Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast
tastemade.us.description: Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - South Texas Deer Capture
tastemade.us.description: Jess visits the East Foundation in South Texas to participate in a fast-paced, yet careful and methodical deer capture.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch
tastemade.us.description: Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin
tastemade.us.description: Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma
tastemade.us.description: With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Northstar Bison Smash Burger
tastemade.us.description: Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

tastemade.us.title: Hardcore Carnivore - Texas Tomahawk from Wyatt Ranches
tastemade.us.description: Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The King of Open-Fire Paella
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E18 Property Brothers: Marc & Stephanie Stephanie and Marc are getting frustrated with their house hunt. They've been outbid on a series of properties in the city, and the Property Brothers try to sell them on a radically different approach.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E06 Property Brothers: Debra & Dan Along with their three small children, Debra and Dan are squeezed into a tiny urban condo. And though they'd prefer to stay in the heart of the city, it's time to find the sprawling suburban home of their dreams.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E20 Property Brothers: Katie & Michael Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighborhood, Katie, Michael, and their three daughters quickly sold their property. But now they're squeezed into a one-bedroom rental until the Property Brothers can find them their forever home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E04 Property Brothers: Kevin and Shirley Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 The Bushland Treehouse Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 From Caravan to Dream Home Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Scotland's Island Cottage Builder Justin and wife Emma tackle an ambitious modular home build on Scotland's remote North Uist.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Mid-Century Poolside Retreat Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tbn.us.title: Inside and Out -- A Christmas to Remember
tbn.us.description: Inside and Out -- A Christmas to Remember

tbs.us.title: Elf
tbs.us.description: Buddy (Will Ferrell) was accidentally transported to the North Pole as a toddler and raised to adulthood among Santa's elves. Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results.

teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde help each other plan the perfect Thanksgiving dinner, from prepping and cooking to eating and enjoying.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - A Star Is Scorned; Senior Moment
teennick.us.description: Lola realizes that double the cuteness could help her break into show business, so she teams up with Lily; Lori vows to make up for lost time in her senior year.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Space Jammed; Crown and Dirty
teennick.us.description: Annoyed by Leni's intrusive babysitting, Lisa accidentally blasts herself and Todd into space; Lola tries to whip Mom into tip-top pageant condition for a mother-daughter pageant.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Don't You Fore-get About Me; Tough Cookies
teennick.us.description: Hit by the realization that her big sister will be going off to college soon, Leni tries to thwart Lori's plans; Lincoln and Clyde start their own cookie-making business, but realize it's a lot more work than they realized.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Project Loud House; In Tents Debate
teennick.us.description: Lincoln has to get his sisters out the door so he can be on time for school; Lincoln holds the deciding vote for the family vacation.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Crashed Course; Puns and Buns
teennick.us.description: The Loud siblings intervene when they think Lori is failing out of Fairway U; Benny struggles to rein in Luan and her practical jokes when she becomes his coworker at the Burpin' Burger.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Blinded by Science; Band Together
teennick.us.description: Lisa searches for the next big scientific breakthrough; Luna decides whether to play in a band with her friends or play with professionals.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loudest Thanksgiving
teennick.us.description: Faced with spending Thanksgiving apart, Lori and Bobby try to bring their crazy families together for the first time.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - For Bros About to Rock; It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is going to his first rock concert, and Luna is determined to make it the greatest experience ever; when Lincoln finds a letter in the attic, he begins to believe there is money hidden somewhere in the house.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Silence of the Luans; Undercover Mom
teennick.us.description: Luan is locked in a cell in the basement; Mom goes undercover as a student at the high school and becomes best friends with Leni, Luna and Luan.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Mad Scientist; Missed Connection
teennick.us.description: Lisa gets invited to work at an institute and get away from her crazy family; Lori and Bobby worry that long-distance dating is causing them to lose their connection.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cow Pie Kid; Saved by the Spell
teennick.us.description: Lynn pushes Liam to his limits when he becomes the star pitcher for the middle school baseball team; Lincoln's friends try to stop him from performing a magic act at the middle school talent show.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Deep Cuts; Game Off
teennick.us.description: When Luna discovers that the high school music club will be axed due to budget cuts, she leads a protest; desperate to play Lincoln's trash-themed video game, Lana conspires to distract her brother away from the console.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Back Out There; Spell It Out
teennick.us.description: Clyde, worried that Lincoln is hung up on Ronnie Anne, tries to cure his post-breakup blues; tired of her siblings walking all over her, Lucy turns to a spell book to teach her siblings a lesson.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Legends; Mall of Duty
teennick.us.description: Dad and Lincoln get on "Legends of the Hidden Temple" and cannot wait to for a whole day of father-and-son bonding; Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he decides to take them to the mall.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Candy Crushed; Master of Delusion
teennick.us.description: Lola struggles to dampen her sweet tooth when mom challenges her to go an entire week without added sugar; Lincoln strives to impress the Amazing Brailster when he's chosen to be his assistant at the Illusion Château.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Grub Snub; She's All Bat
teennick.us.description: When Leni and her friends start hanging out at Gus', Lincoln and the gang start a turf war for control; Lucy gets jealous of Lola's newfound attention after she joins the Mortician's Club.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House of Lies; Game Boys
teennick.us.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs; Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Sister Act; House Flip
teennick.us.description: To get out of doing things they don't like, Lana and Lola secretly switch places and pretend to be the other; after causing Flip to get hurt, the kids sneak him into the attic to care for him without Mom and Dad knowing.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Tails of Woe; The Last Loud on Earth
teennick.us.description: When Stella's music box disappears at school, the gang immediately suspects a student urban legend known as the Rat Beast; after a night of zombie movies, Clyde and Lincoln find an empty Loud house and assume it's a zombie apocalypse.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Jeers for Fears; Tea Tale Heart
teennick.us.description: After agreeing to go to the Royal Woods House of Terror, Lincoln and Clyde have to toughen up and face their fears; Lola discovers that Lucy has an old, fragile doll and decides she must borrow it.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Home of the Fave; Hero Today, Gone Tomorrow
teennick.us.description: After a pun-filled trip to the grocery store with Luan and Lola, Dad worries Lola thinks he plays favorites; when Lynn's friend Margo is celebrated for a one-in-a-million soccer goal, Lynn tries to be supportive.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Price of Admission; One Flu Over the Loud House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is unable to sleep after watching a scary movie, so he stays awake all night; when a common cold spreads through the Loud house, Lincoln believes his sisters have turned into zombies.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fright Bite; The Loudly Bones
teennick.us.description: When a vampire moves into Royal Woods, Lucy must convince him to turn the Mortician's Club into vampires. Sunset Canyon is falling apart and Lincoln and Clyde are determined to find out why.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - 11 Louds a Leapin'
teennick.us.description: As the Louds prepare for Christmas, Lincoln's sled goes into their neighbor's yard, leading Lincoln and Clyde to attempt a rescue mission.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Funny Business; Snow Bored
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Season's Cheatings; A Flipmas Carol
teennick.us.description: Lincoln tries to game the family gift swap and ends up learning a valuable lesson; a Scrooge-like Flip is visited by three ghosts in a take on "A Christmas Carol."

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Way Out; Snow Way Down
teennick.us.description: Lana convinces the children to go to the Burpin' Burger to meet her racecar driving hero despite the heavy snowfall; when Lincoln goes on vacation with Clyde, he realizes how overprotective Clyde's parents are.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Twas the Fight Before Christmas
teennick.us.description: Lincoln recruits his cousins to help end the years-long feud between Dad and Uncle Lance so they can finally celebrate Christmas together.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Escape; Snow News Day
teennick.us.description: To make it to school, the Louds must survive a monstrous Lynn when the weatherman declares it a Packing Day; when there are signs of a yeti in Royal Woods, the Action News Team sets out to prove its existence.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Merry Diss-mass; Just Snow With It
teennick.us.description: Lynn is excited for her Swiss friend Henrik to visit, but she grows nervous when people think they're more than friends; Lincoln and friends start a shoveling business to raise money for David Steele on Ice tickets.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Pulp Friction; Pets Peeved
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde submit an Ace Savvy comic to a meet-the-creator contest, but are foiled by a surprising nemesis; when Lana brings home a new pet, whom the children adore, the four original Loud pets scheme to get rid of him.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Jerk

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Swellview's Got Talent
teennick.us.description: After discovering contestants on Swellview's Got Talent are losing consciousness, Captain Man and Kid Danger enlist the help of Charlotte and Schwoz in order to find out what is causing the mischief.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Holiday Punch
teennick.us.description: When a new species of moth eats all the Christmas trees in Swellview, Captain Man and Kid Danger head over to Neighborville to buy more; on the way back they're attacked by shady tree dealers and have to fight to save Christmas.

teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray must deal with an annoying new villain called the Spoiler; Piper tries to join a popular Captain Man fan club. (family) - 2015-01-24

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Ox Pox

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Christmas Danger
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man gets arrested for committing a petty crime, he is forced to spend Christmas in jail. (family) - 2015-11-28

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Sparks

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - My Wife
that70sshow.us.description: Donna's bachelorette party takes a surprising turn when Kelso's brother, Casey (Luke Wilson), turns out to be the emcee at a strip club.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Going Mobile
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso becomes afraid of fatherhood when he meets Brooke's (Shannon Elizabeth) mother, Carolyn (Morgan Fairchild); Eric has second thoughts about marrying Donna and leaves town to sort things out.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Seeker
that70sshow.us.description: Donna's mother returns to console her daughter; Kitty finds Hyde's birth certificate and makes a discovery about his father; Eric tries to explain his actions to Donna.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Time Is on My Side
that70sshow.us.description: Eric makes plans to sell Donna's engagement ring to fund taking a year off, but when he learns Donna threw it from the water tower the gang goes searching for it, with disastrous results.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Let's Spend the Night Together
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde gets a big surprise when he meets his real father; Eric and Donna attend a feminist rally; Kelso prepares for the arrival of his baby.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction
that70sshow.us.description: Eric tries his hand at vandalism; Red buys a local muffler shop; Kelso's daughter gives him a newfound respect for women.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Beast of Burden
that70sshow.us.description: After Red offers him a job, Hyde must choose between working with Red or his real father; Fez gets a job as a shampoo boy at the local beauty shop.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - It's Only Rock 'n' Roll
that70sshow.us.description: With an empty nest, Kitty decides on a course of self-improvement; Eric decides he wants to be an artist; Hyde learns the joys of business attire.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Rip This Joint
that70sshow.us.description: Eric encourages the gang to pull a prank on a crazy neighbor; Kitty takes a magazine quiz and learns that she has low self-esteem; Bob accuses Midge of flirting with W.B.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Mother's Little Helper
that70sshow.us.description: Fez becomes interested in a hot new client at the salon, but he faces some stiff competition from Kelso.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Angie
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde and his not-so-nice sister, Angie, fight for control of their father's company. Guest star Tim Reid.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - You Can't Always Get What You Want
that70sshow.us.description: Kitty is upset that the kids have other plans for Thanksgiving, Eric has tickets to a Styx concert and Hyde has his store's grand opening.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Surprise, Surprise
